targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  "time_bin" AS "time",
  "core_id",
  "usage"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin",
      "core_id",
      AVG("usage_user" + "usage_system") AS "usage"
    FROM
      "cpu"
    WHERE
      "time" >= $__timeFrom
      AND "time" <= $__timeTo
    GROUP BY
      "core_id",
      "time_bin"
  )
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC

SELECT
  "time_bin" AS "time",
  "usage",
  "total"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin",
      AVG("used") AS "usage",
      AVG("total") AS "total"
    FROM
      "disk"
    WHERE
      "time" >= $__timeFrom
      AND "time" <= $__timeTo
    GROUP BY
      "time_bin"
  )
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', "time") AS "time_bin", AVG("free") AS "free" FROM "disk" WHERE "device" = '$mainDisk' AND "time" >= $__timeFrom AND "time" <= $__timeTo GROUP BY "time_bin" ORDER BY "time_bin" ASC

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', "time") AS "time_bin", AVG("total") AS "total" FROM "disk" WHERE "device" = '$mainDisk' AND "time" >= $__timeFrom AND "time" <= $__timeTo GROUP BY "time_bin" ORDER BY "time_bin" ASC
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', "time") AS "time_bin", AVG("used") AS "used" FROM "mem" WHERE "time" >= $__timeFrom AND "time" <= $__timeTo GROUP BY "time_bin" ORDER BY "time_bin" ASC
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', "time") AS "time_bin", AVG("total") AS "total" FROM "mem" WHERE "time" >= $__timeFrom AND "time" <= $__timeTo GROUP BY "time_bin" ORDER BY "time_bin" ASC

SELECT
  "time_bin" AS "time",
  "usage",
  "total"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin",
      AVG("used") AS "usage",
      AVG("total") AS "total"
    FROM
      "mem"
    WHERE
      "time" >= $__timeFrom
      AND "time" <= $__timeTo
    GROUP BY
      "time_bin"
  )
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC

SELECT
  "time_bin" AS "time",
  "free",
  "total"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin",
      AVG("swap_free") AS "free",
      AVG("swap_total") AS "total"
    FROM
      "mem"
    WHERE
      "time" >= $__timeFrom
      AND "time" <= $__timeTo
    GROUP BY
      "time_bin"
  )
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC

SELECT date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin", AVG("n_containers_stopped") AS "stopped" FROM "docker" WHERE "time" >= $__timeFrom AND "time" <= $__timeTo GROUP BY "time_bin" ORDER BY "time_bin" ASC

SELECT date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin", AVG("n_containers_paused") AS "paused" FROM "docker" WHERE "time" >= $__timeFrom AND "time" <= $__timeTo GROUP BY "time_bin" ORDER BY "time_bin" ASC

SELECT date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin", AVG("n_containers_running") AS "running" FROM "docker" WHERE "time" >= $__timeFrom AND "time" <= $__timeTo GROUP BY "time_bin" ORDER BY "time_bin" ASC

SELECT `com.docker.compose.service` AS "Service", selector_last("container_status", "time")['value'] AS "Status" FROM "docker_container_status" WHERE "time" >= $__timeFrom AND "time" <= $__timeTo GROUP BY `com.docker.compose.service` ORDER BY "Service" ASC

SELECT
  "time_bin" AS "time",
  "service",
  "usage"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin",
      `com.docker.compose.service` AS "service",
      AVG("usage_percent") AS "usage"
    FROM
      "docker_container_cpu"
    WHERE
      "time" >= $__timeFrom
      AND "time" <= $__timeTo
    GROUP BY
      "service",
      "time_bin"
  )
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC

SELECT
  "time_bin" AS "time",
  "service",
  "usage"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      date_bin(COALESCE($interval,'$__interval_ms milliseconds')::INTERVAL, "time") AS "time_bin",
      `com.docker.compose.service` AS "service",
      AVG("usage") AS "usage"
    FROM
      "docker_container_mem"
    WHERE
      "time" >= $__timeFrom
      AND "time" <= $__timeTo
    GROUP BY
      "service",
      "time_bin"
  )
ORDER BY
  "time" ASC
